services.name: TrueNAS
services.securityException: TrueNAS HTTPS/API is intentionally published on public port 7000 by pfSense HAProxy, which terminates public TLS and re-encrypts to 172.17.0.24:7000. FastAPI Cloud requires this WAN path and currently has no user-controlled static egress/tunnel; keep the exposure visible as an accepted security exception, require TLS/API authentication, and validate access from approved and untrusted origins separately.

services.name: pfSense
services.securityException: The pfSense administration/API listener on 10443 is a trusted-source-only endpoint. FastAPI Cloud is not an approved administration source: direct reachability from that runtime is a negative exposure check and a security-policy failure. Keep administration limited to approved stable sources, use dedicated least-privilege API identities, and move durable posture/Snort telemetry to an out-of-band observer.

services.name: Home
services.securityException: home.albandrieu.com:10443 aliases the pfSense administration/API listener. This source-aware policy permits only approved stable administration sources; FastAPI Cloud direct reachability is intentionally treated as a policy failure until a controlled workload identity or out-of-band observer is used.

services.name: Garage S3 API
services.securityException: Garage S3 API must be LAN/VPN only; public DNS/NAT/Tunnel exposure is unauthorized.
services.description: Private Garage S3-compatible API :3900, intended only for LAN/VPN clients.

services.name: Garage Web UI
services.healthNote: Garage Web UI :3909 should be the only temporarily public Garage surface; actual tunnel routing must be audited.
services.description: Garage Web UI on :3909; temporarily public behind controlled access. Verify actual Cloudflare origin.

services.name: Garage Admin API
services.healthNote: Garage Admin API must be LAN/VPN only; verify removal of any public tunnel route.
services.description: Private Garage Admin API :3903, distinct from the browser Web UI.

services.name: Bichon
services.securityException: Bichon must stay private. Any public DNS or Cloudflare Tunnel entry is configuration drift and must be reported by sickz.

services.name: n8n
services.securityException: n8n currently needs a public webhook path for integrations such as Slack. A broad Cloudflare Access bypass/Everyone policy is intentionally treated as a red security exception; narrow it to the webhook path or replace it with Service Auth.

services.name: PostgreSQL
services.healthNote: ⚠️ Internal-only database service. FastAPI Sample cloud uses Supabase instead of this PostgreSQL instance. The canonical endpoint is retained for identity/presentation but must not be probed externally while external=false. Internal health uses TCP/5432.

services.name: ClamAV
services.healthNote: ⚠️ Internal-only antivirus engine. The canonical URL is retained for identity/presentation but must not be probed externally while external=false. Internal health uses TCP/3310; internal DNS identity is https://clamav.int.albandrieu.com.

services.name: Reactive Resume
services.healthNote: Reactive Resume is intentionally exposed at https://reactive.albandrieu.com. Runtime, public HTTPS reachability and tunnel/edge evidence should reconcile to green when healthy.
